summary: Iteration 143 - Payroll Rate Matrix & Bug Tracker fully tested. Backend: 47/47 tests passed. All endpoints working correctly. Frontend: All UI components verified - Rate Matrix grid with cell editor, Bug Tracker with ticket list, new ticket dialog, detail drawer with triage controls.

tests: PUT /api/payroll-matrix/{user_id}/{property_id} updates cell with hourly rate
PUT /api/payroll-matrix/{user_id}/{property_id} updates cell with daily rate + split
PUT /api/payroll-matrix/{user_id}/{property_id} with rate=0 and active=false deletes cell
POST /api/bug-tracker creates ticket with created_by_* fields
GET /api/bug-tracker lists tickets with stats (total, new, in_progress, resolved, critical, by_status)
POST /api/bug-tracker/{id}/comments appends comment with author metadata
Rate Matrix sidebar button (data-testid=rate-matrix-btn) opens panel
Hero section with title 'Every rate. Every branch. One grid.'
Matrix table (data-testid=matrix-table) displays users × properties grid
Cell editor has payment type toggle (hourly/daily)
Cell editor has Save and Remove buttons
Bug Tracker sidebar button (data-testid=bug-tracker-btn) opens panel
Hero section with title 'Break things, report things, fix things.'
Status tabs (tab-all, tab-new, tab-triaged, tab-in_progress, tab-resolved, tab-closed) present
Report button (data-testid=bug-new) opens new ticket dialog
New ticket dialog has title input, type select, priority select, area select, description, url fields
Submit button creates ticket and shows in list
Detail drawer shows Triage section for admin (status, priority, assignee selects)
Detail drawer has comment input and send button
Detail drawer has Delete button for admin

critical_code_review_comments: Payroll Matrix correctly stores cell data in users.branch_payments[property_id]
Bug Tracker correctly validates type/priority enums before insert/update
Bug Tracker correctly restricts non-admin users to see only own+assigned tickets
Bug Tracker assignees endpoint correctly filters to admin+manager roles only
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Cell editor correctly shows split option only for daily payment type
seed_data_creation: Test tickets created during testing were cleaned up. One rate cell may remain for Hotel Admin at Vilenza Hotel (£100/h).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 143 tested Payroll Rate Matrix and Bug Tracker modules. Both backend APIs and frontend UIs are fully functional. Rate Matrix allows admin to set hourly/daily rates per staff per property with split and active toggles. Bug Tracker allows any authenticated user to file tickets, admin/manager can triage (status, priority, assign, comment, resolve, delete). All data-testid attributes are in place for automated testing.
